name: Alfamén (Spain)
description: Green field with two wavy stripes of white and blue towards the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with a white fountain.
history: Municipal flag of Alfamén; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
